DAY built on white: high-key paper-white haze, pale packed earth, the figure the dark inked thing. WORM’S-EYE from the dirt. ONE DEVICE: the crooked yard path as a hard diagonal. Wonganghami (FACE from attached portrait) mid-labor — five clay water bowls stacked and strapped on her bent back, vermilion-orange servant po mud-stained and frayed, braid stuck to sweat, jaw set, not crying yet, not smiling. A dark timber munru eave and stone well rim in soft bokeh. #e85a32 as the hard low-sun key on her cheek and the wet bowls — real light, never a glow. Harsh childhood-of-the-house mood. No text.
